
```{r}
###########################################################################
###########################################################################
###                                                                     ###
###                           FIGURE 3B                                 ###
###                                                                     ###
###########################################################################
###########################################################################

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

celltype_map <- c(
  "CD8.positive..alpha.beta.T.cell" = "CD8+T",
  "CD4.positive..alpha.beta.T.cell" = "CD4+T",
  "B.cell" = "B cell",
  "natural.killer.cell" = "NK cell",
  "inflammatory.macrophage" = "anti-tumor macrophage",
  "alternatively.activated.macrophage" = "pro-tumor macrophage",
  "macrophage" = "not in group",
  "myeloid.cell" = "Myeloid",
  "T.cell" = "not in group",
  "fibroblast" = "Fibroblast",
  "endothelial.cell" = "Endothelial",
  "neutrophil" = "Neutrophil",
  "malignant.cell" = "not in group"
)

tumor_group_map <- c(
  "Gyn" = "UCEC.MSI", "Gyn" = "UCEC.MSS", "Gyn" = "OV",
  "Squamous" = "CESC", "Squamous" = "LUSC", "Squamous" = "HNSC.HPVneg", "Squamous" = "ESCA.SC", "Squamous" = "BLCA",
  "Adeno" = "BRCA.pos", "Adeno" = "BRCA.neg", "Adeno" = "PRAD", "Adeno" = "LUAD", "Adeno" = "LIHC",
  "GI" = "COADREAD.MSI", "GI" = "COADREAD.MSS", "GI" = "ESCA.AD", "GI" = "STAD", "GI" = "PAAD",
  "Kidney" = "KICH", "Kidney" = "KIRC", "Kidney" = "KIRP",
  "NC-Derived" = "GBM", "NC-Derived" = "LGG", "NC-Derived" = "SKCM", "NC-Derived" = "UVM",
  "Other" = "ACC", "Other" = "MESO", "Other" = "PCPG", "Other" = "SARC", "Other" = "TGCT", "Other" = "UCS"
)

##################################################
## load & preprocess (done once)
##################################################
arm_hit <- read.csv( "./input/xcell_cr_linear_regression_Outputs_ArmCNV.csv", row.names = 1)
arm_hit$Arm <- arm_hit$Cytoband
arm_hit$CellType <- celltype_map[arm_hit$CellType]
arm_hit <- arm_hit[arm_hit$CellType != "not in group", ]
arm_hit$CellType <- factor(
  arm_hit$CellType,
  levels = c(
    "CD8+T", "CD4+T", "B cell", "NK cell",
    "anti-tumor macrophage", "pro-tumor macrophage",
    "Myeloid", "Neutrophil", "Fibroblast", "Endothelial"
  )
)
arm_hit <- arm_hit %>%
  group_by(TumorType, CellType) %>%
  mutate(BH = p.adjust(P_val, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()
arm_hit$hit_value <- arm_hit$cnv_status * arm_hit$X.signedlog.P.adj.
arm_hit$hit_group <- ifelse(arm_hit$hit_value > 0, "high", "low")
arm_hit$EventType <- factor(
  ifelse(arm_hit$cnv_status > 0, "Gain", "Loss"),
  levels = c("Gain", "Loss")
)
arm_hit <- arm_hit[arm_hit$BH < 0.2, ]
arm_hit$tumor_group <- unlist(
  sapply(arm_hit$TumorType, function(x) {
    res <- names(tumor_group_map)[tumor_group_map == x]
    if (length(res) == 0) res <- "not in group"
    return(res)
  })
)
arm_hit <- arm_hit[arm_hit$tumor_group != "not in group", ]

##################################################
## shared plot settings
##################################################
event_colors <- c("Gain" = "#B00020", "Loss" = "#0B3D91")
event_colors <- c("Gain" = "#ED1C24", "Loss" = "#384ca0")

shared_theme <- theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.direction   = "horizontal",
    legend.box         = "vertical",
    legend.title       = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y       = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 14),
    strip.text         = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.text        = element_text(size = 15),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 1),
    plot.title         = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
  )

make_panel <- function(df, title, y_max, show_y = TRUE) {
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = EventType, y = n, fill = EventType)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.55, position = "stack", alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = event_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) + # keep empty factor levels
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_max)) + # shared y scale
    ggtitle(title) +
    xlab("") +
    shared_theme
  if (show_y) p <- p + ylab("Number of Arm SCNAs") else p <- p + ylab("")
  p
}

##################################################
## iterations: All tumors + GI subset
##################################################
runs <- list(
  list(label = "All", data = arm_hit, suffix = ""),
  list(label = "GI", data = arm_hit[arm_hit$tumor_group == "GI", ], suffix = "_GI")
)

for (run in runs) {
  dat <- run$data

  left_df <- dat %>%
    filter(CellType %in% c("CD8+T", "CD4+T", "NK cell"), hit_group == "low") %>%
    dplyr::count(EventType)
  mid_df <- dat %>%
    filter(CellType == "anti-tumor macrophage", hit_group == "low") %>%
    dplyr::count(EventType)
  right_df <- dat %>%
    filter(CellType == "pro-tumor macrophage", hit_group == "high") %>%
    dplyr::count(EventType)

  # shared y ceiling across all three panels
  y_max <- max(c(left_df$n, mid_df$n, right_df$n), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05

  p_left  <- make_panel(left_df,  "TME Cold - Lymphoid\nCD8+T / CD4+T / NK cell (Low)", y_max, show_y = TRUE)
  p_mid   <- make_panel(mid_df,   "TME Cold - Myeloid\nAnti-tumor Macrophage (Low)",    y_max, show_y = FALSE)
  p_right <- make_panel(right_df, "TME Cold - Myeloid\nPro-tumor Macrophage (High)",    y_max, show_y = FALSE)

  combined <- p_left + p_mid + p_right +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect", widths = c(1.2, 1, 1)) &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  print(combined)
}
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

celltype_map <- c(
  "CD8.positive..alpha.beta.T.cell" = "CD8+T",
  "CD4.positive..alpha.beta.T.cell" = "CD4+T",
  "B.cell" = "B cell",
  "natural.killer.cell" = "NK cell",
  "inflammatory.macrophage" = "anti-tumor macrophage",
  "alternatively.activated.macrophage" = "pro-tumor macrophage",
  "macrophage" = "not in group",
  "myeloid.cell" = "Myeloid",
  "T.cell" = "not in group",
  "fibroblast" = "Fibroblast",
  "endothelial.cell" = "Endothelial",
  "neutrophil" = "Neutrophil",
  "malignant.cell" = "not in group"
)

tumor_group_map <- c(
  "Gyn"="UCEC.MSI", "Gyn"="UCEC.MSS", "Gyn"="OV",
  "Squamous"="CESC","Squamous"="LUSC", "Squamous"="HNSC.HPVneg", "Squamous"="ESCA.SC","Squamous"="BLCA",
  "Adeno" = "BRCA.pos","Adeno" = "BRCA.neg","Adeno" = "PRAD","Adeno" = "LUAD","Adeno" = "LIHC",
  "GI"="COADREAD.MSI", "GI"="COADREAD.MSS", "GI"="ESCA.AD", "GI"="STAD", "GI"="PAAD",
  "Kidney"="KICH", "Kidney"="KIRC", "Kidney"="KIRP",
  "NC-Derived"="GBM", "NC-Derived"="LGG", "NC-Derived"="SKCM", "NC-Derived"="UVM",
  "Other" = "ACC","Other" = "MESO","Other"="PCPG", "Other"="SARC", "Other"="TGCT", "Other"="UCS"
)

##################################################
## load & preprocess
##################################################
arm_hit <- read.csv(
  "/Users/ze/Desktop/Ze_figure_github/input/xcell_cr_linear_regression_Outputs_ArmCNV.csv",
  row.names = 1
)
arm_hit$Arm <- arm_hit$Cytoband

cyto_hit <- read.csv(
  "/Users/ze/Desktop/Ze_figure_github/input/xcell_cr_linear_regression_Outputs_CytoCNV.csv",
  row.names = 1
)
cyto_hit$Arm <- paste0("Arm", cyto_hit$ChrArm)

preprocess <- function(df) {
  df$CellType <- celltype_map[df$CellType]
  df <- df[!is.na(df$CellType) & df$CellType != "not in group", ]
  df$CellType <- factor(df$CellType, levels = c(
    "CD8+T", "CD4+T", "B cell", "NK cell",
    "anti-tumor macrophage", "pro-tumor macrophage",
    "Myeloid", "Neutrophil", "Fibroblast", "Endothelial"
  ))
  df <- df %>%
    group_by(TumorType, CellType) %>%
    mutate(BH = p.adjust(P_val, method = "BH")) %>%
    ungroup()
  df$hit_value <- df$cnv_status * df$X.signedlog.P.adj.
  df$hit_group <- ifelse(df$hit_value > 0, "high", "low")
  df$EventType <- factor(
    ifelse(df$cnv_status > 0, "Gain", "Loss"),
    levels = c("Gain", "Loss")
  )
  df <- df[df$BH < 0.2, ]
  df$tumor_group <- unlist(
    sapply(df$TumorType, function(x) {
      res <- names(tumor_group_map)[tumor_group_map == x]
      if (length(res) == 0) res <- "not in group"
      return(res)
    })
  )
  df <- df[df$tumor_group != "not in group", ]
  return(df)
}

arm_hit  <- preprocess(arm_hit)
cyto_hit <- preprocess(cyto_hit)

##################################################
## colors & theme
##################################################
event_colors <- c("1q Gain" = "#B00020", "9p Loss" = "#0B3D91")

shared_theme <- theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.direction    = "horizontal",
    legend.title        = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y        = element_text(size = 22),
    axis.text.x         = element_text(size = 20, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y         = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.text         = element_text(size = 20),
    strip.text          = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor    = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y  = element_line(linewidth = 1),
    plot.title          = element_text(size = 22, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position     = "bottom"
  )

# complete counts helper: ensures ALL CellGroups x EventLabels always present
complete_counts <- function(df) {
  all_combos <- expand.grid(
    CellGroup  = factor(c("Low Lymphoid", "Low Anti-tumor Macrophage"),
                        levels = c("Low Lymphoid", "Low Anti-tumor Macrophage")),
    EventLabel = factor(c("1q Gain", "9p Loss"), levels = c("1q Gain", "9p Loss")),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  all_combos %>%
    left_join(df, by = c("CellGroup", "EventLabel")) %>%
    mutate(n = ifelse(is.na(n), 0L, n))
}

##################################################
## faceted panel builders
##################################################

# arm-level: facet by cell group, shared y scale
make_arm_facet <- function(arm_data, title = "Arm level") {
  df <- bind_rows(
    arm_data %>%
      filter(CellType %in% c("CD8+T", "CD4+T", "NK cell"), hit_group == "low") %>%
      filter((Arm == "Arm1q" & EventType == "Gain") | (Arm == "Arm9p" & EventType == "Loss")) %>%
      mutate(EventLabel = factor(ifelse(Arm == "Arm1q", "1q Gain", "9p Loss"),
                                 levels = c("1q Gain", "9p Loss")),
             CellGroup = "Low Lymphoid"),
    arm_data %>%
      filter(CellType == "anti-tumor macrophage", hit_group == "low") %>%
      filter((Arm == "Arm1q" & EventType == "Gain") | (Arm == "Arm9p" & EventType == "Loss")) %>%
      mutate(EventLabel = factor(ifelse(Arm == "Arm1q", "1q Gain", "9p Loss"),
                                 levels = c("1q Gain", "9p Loss")),
             CellGroup = "Low Anti-tumor Macrophage")
  )

  counts <- if (nrow(df) > 0) dplyr::count(df, CellGroup, EventLabel) else data.frame()
  df <- complete_counts(counts)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = EventLabel, y = n, fill = EventLabel)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.55) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = event_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ CellGroup, ncol = 2, scales = "fixed") +
    ggtitle(title) +
    xlab("") + ylab("Number of significant SCNAs") +
    shared_theme
}

# cytoband-level: facet by cell group, shared y scale
make_cyto_facet <- function(cyto_data, title = "Cytoband level") {
  df <- bind_rows(
    cyto_data %>%
      filter(CellType %in% c("CD8+T", "CD4+T", "NK cell"), hit_group == "low") %>%
      filter((ChrArm == "1q" & EventType == "Gain") | (ChrArm == "9p" & EventType == "Loss")) %>%
      mutate(EventLabel = factor(ifelse(ChrArm == "1q", "1q Gain", "9p Loss"),
                                 levels = c("1q Gain", "9p Loss")),
             CellGroup = "Low Lymphoid"),
    cyto_data %>%
      filter(CellType == "anti-tumor macrophage", hit_group == "low") %>%
      filter((ChrArm == "1q" & EventType == "Gain") | (ChrArm == "9p" & EventType == "Loss")) %>%
      mutate(EventLabel = factor(ifelse(ChrArm == "1q", "1q Gain", "9p Loss"),
                                 levels = c("1q Gain", "9p Loss")),
             CellGroup = "Low Anti-tumor Macrophage")
  )

  counts <- if (nrow(df) > 0) dplyr::count(df, CellGroup, EventLabel) else data.frame()
  df <- complete_counts(counts)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = EventLabel, y = n, fill = EventLabel)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.55) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = event_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ CellGroup, ncol = 2, scales = "fixed") +
    ggtitle(title) +
    xlab("") + ylab("") +
    shared_theme
}

##################################################
## make one row per tumor group
##################################################
make_row <- function(arm_data, cyto_data, tg_label) {
  p_arm  <- make_arm_facet( arm_data,  "Arm level")
  p_cyto <- make_cyto_facet(cyto_data, "Cytoband level")

  row <- p_arm + p_cyto +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect", widths = c(1, 1)) &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  row_annotated <- row +
    plot_annotation(
      title = tg_label,
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
    )
  wrap_elements(full = patchworkGrob(row_annotated))
}

##################################################
## loop over tumor groups
##################################################
tumor_subsets <- c("All", "Squamous", "Adeno", "NC-Derived")

row_list <- list()
for (tg in tumor_subsets) {
  if (tg == "All") {
    arm_sub  <- arm_hit
    cyto_sub <- cyto_hit
  } else {
    arm_sub  <- arm_hit  %>% filter(tumor_group == tg)
    cyto_sub <- cyto_hit %>% filter(tumor_group == tg)
  }
  row_list[[tg]] <- make_row(arm_sub, cyto_sub, tg)
}

##################################################
## stack rows & save
##################################################
combined <- wrap_plots(row_list, ncol = 1)

print(combined)
```
